variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: A production evaluation pipeline is a versioned decision system that tests an AI change before release and keeps measuring it after launch. It connects prompts, models, retrieval data, tools, scoring rules, human review, deployment controls, and production outcomes into one traceable evidence path.
variants.prompt: From the lesson section “Follow one evidence contract from change to outcome”: match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Declare the change
pairs.detail: Record the candidate model, prompt, retrieval snapshot, tool versions, decoding settings, and affected product claims.
pairs.explanation: Record the candidate model, prompt, retrieval snapshot, tool versions, decoding settings, and affected product claims.

pairs.label: Run targeted evidence
pairs.detail: Execute deterministic checks, changed-path regressions, product cases, critical slices, and calibrated judgment.
pairs.explanation: Execute deterministic checks, changed-path regressions, product cases, critical slices, and calibrated judgment.

pairs.label: Apply release gates
pairs.detail: Compare with a frozen baseline using uncertainty bounds, hard safety limits, slice floors, and operational budgets.
pairs.explanation: Compare with a frozen baseline using uncertainty bounds, hard safety limits, slice floors, and operational budgets.

pairs.label: Grant bounded exposure
pairs.detail: Start in shadow or a small canary, attach abort criteria, and retain a last known-good rollback target.
pairs.explanation: Start in shadow or a small canary, attach abort criteria, and retain a last known-good rollback target.

pairs.label: Join live outcomes
pairs.detail: Connect traces to quality, safety, latency, cost, feedback, and delayed task outcomes by release identity and cohort.
pairs.explanation: Connect traces to quality, safety, latency, cost, feedback, and delayed task outcomes by release identity and cohort.

pairs.label: Contain and learn
pairs.detail: Pause or roll back a failing route, preserve incident evidence, and add validated failures to a future regression set.
pairs.explanation: Pause or roll back a failing route, preserve incident evidence, and add validated failures to a future regression set.

variants.hint: Give each part the one job only it can do, then rule out the rest. If benchmarks and scoring are new, review comprehensive evaluation benchmarks before designing the automation around them.
variants.explanation: Each part has a distinct responsibility. Declare the change: Record the candidate model, prompt, retrieval snapshot, tool versions, decoding settings, and affected product claims. Run targeted evidence: Execute deterministic checks, changed-path regressions, product cases, critical slices, and calibrated judgment. Apply release gates: Compare with a frozen baseline using uncertainty bounds, hard safety limits, slice floors, and operational budgets. Grant bounded exposure: Start in shadow or a small canary, attach abort criteria, and retain a last known-good rollback target. Join live outcomes: Connect traces to quality, safety, latency, cost, feedback, and delayed task outcomes by release identity and cohort. Contain and learn: Pause or roll back a failing route, preserve incident evidence, and add validated failures to a future regression set.

variants.title: Make the decision
variants.context: A production evaluation pipeline is a versioned decision system that tests an AI change before release and keeps measuring it after launch. It connects prompts, models, retrieval data, tools, scoring rules, human review, deployment controls, and production outcomes into one traceable evidence path.
variants.prompt: What is the core invariant of a production evaluation pipeline?
options: Every promotion or rollback must be reproducible from versioned evidence and decision state
Every model change must run the same number of test cases
A single blended score must determine every release
Production feedback should replace offline evaluation
variants.explanation: The candidate, baseline, data, scoring protocol, thresholds, exposure, and decision owner must be recoverable. Test volume alone does not make evidence valid.
optionFeedback: The candidate, baseline, data, scoring protocol, thresholds, exposure, and decision owner must be recoverable. Test volume alone does not make evidence valid.

variants.hint: Think about the key idea first: It matters because a model can improve on an average offline score while becoming worse for one user group, slower under real traffic, unsafe on a critical case, or expensive enough to break the product.

variants.prompt: An automated judge scores every case, but agreement with qualified humans is only 67% on policy-sensitive outputs. What is the correct pipeline response?
options: Treat calibration as failed and route disagreements to human review
Use the judge because it evaluated more cases
Average the judge score with latency
Hide the disagreement slice from the release report
variants.explanation: Coverage is not correctness. Low agreement weakens the evidence and requires rubric repair, recalibration, or qualified adjudication.

variants.prompt: Why should a validated production incident be retained after rollback?
options: It can become versioned regression evidence while preserving the incident decision trail
It guarantees that the model will never fail again
It should immediately replace the untouched release holdout
It allows thresholds to be removed from future releases
variants.explanation: Validated failures improve future coverage, but they must enter a new dataset version and remain separated from an untouched holdout used for independent release claims.

variants.prompt: A candidate's quality point estimate is 2 percentage points above baseline, but the conservative difference is -2.5 points and the allowed regression is 1 point. What should the gate do?
options: Hold or gather stronger evidence because the conservative result exceeds the tolerance
Promote because the point estimate is positive
Remove difficult cases until the interval passes
Ignore uncertainty whenever the candidate average is higher
variants.explanation: The observed sample still permits a regression larger than the predeclared tolerance. More independent evidence can narrow uncertainty; post-hoc case removal invalidates the comparison.

Replace the slice with random production feedback

A screenshot of the top-line dashboard
